summary: Five family members from Kansas/Missouri lost overnight on the Colorado Trail near North Fork road after an evening hike with no supplies; two self-exited at Payne Gulch Trailhead, three found off-trail and all reunited
location: Colorado Trail near North Fork road / Payne Gulch Trailhead
notes: Date approximate: July 2016; listed as first of month. Large search effort next morning; PCSAR foot teams obtained voice contact with the three off-trail hikers waiting 'on a rock'; ATVs and vehicle transport used in the reunification.
